paper.central_claim: ChemAgent 把化学题分解为原子子任务，构建并在运行时自更新由规划记忆、执行记忆、知识记忆组成的库（含评估-精修模块），使 LLM 的化学推理随经验提升；SciBench 四个化学数据集上 GPT-4 相对直接推理最高 +46%，较 StructChem 平均 +10%。
paper.title: ChemAgent: Self-updating Library in Large Language Models Improves Chemical Reasoning

evidence.quote: these methods often rely heavily on human-curated knowledge ( Chan et al., 2023 ) , or fixed workflows
evidence.support_explanation: 作者 gap：现有化学推理依赖人工知识或固定流程。

evidence.quote: these methods lack the ability to remember and learn from past analogous problems.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者 gap：不能记忆并从相似题学习。

evidence.quote: facilitates iterative problem-solving by continuously updating and refining its content based on task decomposition.
evidence.support_explanation: 核心主张：基于任务分解持续更新库。

evidence.quote: Specifically, our approach leverages the development set to build a library, which is designed to dynamically self-improve during runtime.
evidence.support_explanation: 库先由开发集构建，再运行时自更新。

evidence.quote: As a collection of problems and solutions already exists in the dataset
evidence.support_explanation: 初始库用开发集的人写标准解答分解而成（金标）。

evidence.quote: In addition to ranking, we discard any memory units that do not meet a predefined confidence threshold, as evaluated by the LLMs.
evidence.support_explanation: 库构建期的 LLM 置信度过滤；阈值数值未给出。

evidence.quote: Memory units with similarity above a predefined threshold
evidence.support_explanation: 检索按嵌入相似度阈值；阈值未给数值，另限制 Mp 2 条/Me 4 条。

evidence.quote: Moreover, the memory is continuously updated with newly solved sub-tasks and their solutions during runtime.
evidence.support_explanation: 运行时写入新解决子任务，未描述正确性门控。

evidence.quote: all related responses and knowledge from that process are added to the library if the solution is correct.
evidence.support_explanation: 自进化分析中仅正确解写入，但「correct」判据来源未说明（可能是真值）。

evidence.quote: To ensure accuracy and prevent target leakage, the memory derived from problem
evidence.support_explanation: 自进化迭代中对同题记忆做排除，防止目标泄漏。

evidence.quote: ChemAgent can enhance its performance through a simple correct-or-not evaluation of past solutions instead of human-written high-quality trajectories.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者把自进化收益归因于对过往解的正误评价。

evidence.quote: We test ChemAgent twice for each iteration, and the difference between the two results serves as the error margin.
evidence.support_explanation: 自进化曲线仅两次运行，误差=两次之差。

evidence.quote: we enrich the memory with the required information by leveraging the internal parametric knowledge of LLMs.
evidence.support_explanation: 无相似子任务时由 LLM 自造「合成执行记忆」，未经外部验证。
GPT-4 基线：直接推理 19.48，StructChem 47.66。

evidence.quote: ChemAgent 74.36 48.98 61.18 44.12 57.16 w/o Evaluation & Refinement 61.54 44.89 57.94 44.12 52.12 w/o Memory , Evaluation & Refinement 58.97 38.78 57.94 41.18 49.22
evidence.support_explanation: ChemAgent 57.16；去 E&R 52.12；再去记忆 49.22。ATKINS 61.18 对 n=107 非整数比例（our_inference，疑为 61.68）。

evidence.quote: The results are from the original benchmark, SciBench ( Wang et al., 2024a ) .
evidence.support_explanation: Few-shot+Python 结果取自原基准，非同条件复跑。

evidence.quote: the source of the data is StructChem ( Ouyang et al., 2024 ) .
evidence.support_explanation: 直接推理基线数据来自 StructChem 论文。
无记忆组件时加权均值 51.53（无 E&R）。
仅 Mp+Me（无知识记忆）加权均值 51.53，与 None 相同；完整三记忆 53.71。

evidence.quote: Firstly, removing any memory component results in an overall performance drop.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者结论为任一记忆去掉都下降，Mk 贡献最大（后文）。

evidence.quote: GPT-3.5 Memory 11.22 36.73 GPT-4 Memory 13.26 44.89 Hybrid Memory 10.20 28.57
evidence.support_explanation: 记忆质量影响显著；混合记忆最差。

evidence.quote: On average, each problem requires 0.012 million tokens without the Evaluation & Refinement module, equivalent to around $0.09 per example.
evidence.support_explanation: 报告了每题 token 与美元成本。

evidence.quote: Note that the initial library construction is not included in these calculations as it is a one-time setup.
evidence.support_explanation: 库构建成本被排除。

evidence.quote: While the cost and resource consumption are slightly higher than StructChem, the improvements justify the additional expense.
evidence.support_explanation: 成本高于 StructChem，但无预算匹配对照。

evidence.quote: it sometimes invokes misleading information, even when the similarity between the invoked memory and the problem is high.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认误检索。

evidence.quote: CHEMMC Quantum mechanics 39 (9) 0.231 MATTER Chemistry kinetics 49 (10) 0.204 ATKINS Physical chemistry 107 (16) 0.150 QUAN Quantum
evidence.support_explanation: 测试集 34–107 题，开发集 8–16 题。

evidence.quote: We evaluate the accuracy by comparing their outputs with the correct answers, using a relative tolerance of 0.01.
evidence.support_explanation: 数值答案对照真值，相对容差 0.01。

evidence.quote: We also conducted a Chi-Square Test of Independence to assess the relationship between a similarity threshold
evidence.support_explanation: 相似度与正确性的事后卡方检验，相关而非因果，阈值 0.805 来源不明。

evidence.quote: Each experiment is repeated at least 3 times, and the results are averaged.
evidence.support_explanation: 开源模型实验重复≥3 次取均值，未报告方差。
GPT-3.5：记忆使均值 24.69→31.82，与 StructChem 31.65 相当。
Llama3.1-7b 在 ATKINS 上低于直接推理（19.63 vs 22.43）。

evidence.quote: ChemAgent improves by 9.50% (47.66 vs. 57.16) over StructChem, which is a 2.93 times increase
evidence.support_explanation: 文中算术/表述错误：57.16/47.66≈1.2 倍而非 2.93 倍，摘要 46% 与结论 36% 亦不一致。

evidence.quote: due to limitations in budget and computational resources, we demonstrate our approach solely in the context of chemistry
evidence.support_explanation: 仅化学域验证。

evidence.quote: The evaluation & refinement module can use a different LLM than the one used for the base reasoning process.
evidence.support_explanation: E&R 可由更强 LLM 担任，使对弱模型的比较不再同模型。

evidence.quote: Interestingly, hybrid memory performs the worst among the three settings.
evidence.support_explanation: 混合不同来源记忆会损害性能，提示记忆合并/冲突问题。

evidence.quote: the agent’s performance gradually improves and converges to a
evidence.support_explanation: 自进化曲线随迭代上升并收敛到高于基线（44.89%）。

evidence.quote: achieving up to a 36% improvement
evidence.support_explanation: 结论中为 36%，与摘要 46% 不一致。

signatures.conditions: 无相似记忆时 LLM 自造合成记忆
signatures.feedback: LLM 置信度评估；§2.9 为正误判断
signatures.selection_rule/data: 初始：LLM 置信度阈值；运行时：§2.5 未说明门控，§2.9 仅正确解入库

signatures.later_use: 后续子任务检索注入 prompt
signatures.claimed_effect: GPT-4 平均 57.16（无记忆无 E&R 49.22）
signatures.failure_boundary: 误检索、混合记忆更差、开发集小导致记忆薄弱（ATKINS）

signatures.object: 评估-精修模块（运行时对子解和计划的修正）
signatures.operation: 检查冲突与常见错误，重写子解或重构后续子任务
signatures.conditions: 最多若干次试验；可由更强 LLM 担任

gap.author_gap: 化学多步推理易级联出错；现有方法靠人工知识或固定流程，不能从过往相似题记忆并学习。
gap.checked_gap: 领域缺陷（公式/单位/代码错误）有案例（Fig 1）支持，但「缺记忆」作为瓶颈未经诊断实验证明；对外部记忆系统近邻仅一句话区分（「整合全部组件并动态更新」），没有与 ExpeL/AWM/Voyager 类留存方法的对比。
gap.lineage/closest_adjacent: StructChem（结构化推理+置信审查）、few-shot+Python（SciBench）、外部记忆（Huang 2024a, Zhong 2024a 等），自演化框架（Qian 2024 等）。本地无这些全文，依赖本文描述。
gap.residue: 留存库本身的边际收益小且混杂（见 E019 与 Mk 优势）；运行时写入门控不清；开发集极小。
gap.stakes: 化学计算题错误级联，GPT-4 直接推理仅 19.48%。
gap.method_response: 分解+三类记忆+评估精修，直接回应公式、步骤与代码错误。
gap.remaining_gap: 记忆是否是增益来源、写入质量、泛化到其他领域、与其他记忆方法的对比。
unresolved: 外部记忆/自演化近邻全文不在包内；缺少与同类留存方法的实验对比
